title: Rabbi Menachem Yodpaa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Zevachim 110b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.110b.4): Rabbi Yochanan said in his name that Rabbi Elazar stated the teaching according to the view of Rabbi Akiva, his teacher. [Meilah 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Meilah.13b.8) has Rabbi Menachem Yodapa; [Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sukkah.4.6.2) has Yose bar Chanina speaking in the name of Menachem Yotapya.[^1]

notes.text: Zevachim gives Rabbi Menachem Yodpaah, Meilah gives Menachem Yodapa without the title, and the Jerusalem Talmud gives Menachem Yotapya. Compare [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2488&lang=en) for all three passages.
